query: Audit this repository against our Java conventions.
expected_behavior: Scopes to the repository's main Java source, sampling representatively (and saying so) if the repo is large
Delegates to the java-reviewer agent (or follows the inline fallback reading the relevant SKILL.md files) rather than reviewing from memory
Produces one consolidated report: verdict, severity-grouped findings with file:line and the violated rule, and what was checked clean
Audits only files changed on the current branch (staged, unstaged, and commits not on the default branch)
Does not expand scope to unchanged files except flagging pre-existing issues as optional follow-ups
Reports severity-grouped findings with file:line citations
Audits exactly the named directory plus its immediate tests
Loads java-development conventions and adds java-testing for the test files
States what was out of scope so silence is distinguishable from reviewed-clean
